findings.message: Renaming the public attribute `queue` to `queue_uri` and then re-defining `queue` as a property that returns the (new) trigger-routing queue silently changes what existing callers read: any DAG or out-of-tree subclass doing `MessageQueueTrigger(...).queue` used to get the broker URI and will now get `None`. Keep `queue` returning the broker URI (deprecating it if needed) and expose the new routing value under the new name only, or add a deprecation shim so the old attribute keeps working.
